review:
Independently reviewed all 19 exact test call paths. Request deserialization and block construction are pure. Manager tests use SessionState, Noop emitter and in-memory channels for accepted, rejected, cancelled, cleared and switched provider/model snapshots, including strict-to-legacy turns; Office has no mentioned scene and memory has no installed database handle, so both return before external access. Five SDK-effort tests exercise only pure level resolution, exact request validation, argv and YAML patch construction, plus a content-hash cache using private temporary JSON and a non-executed placeholder file. These tests never call native inspect/run_probe, load an installed SDK, initialize an Agent/Session, install anything or launch a CLI process. WhatsApp relay/health suites and all database-dependent tests remain compile-only. The v0.30.10-80 changes affect WhatsApp reply pacing and version metadata, outside the allowed Prompt call paths. No AppDatabase, SQLite, SQL, migrations, agent processes or network are executed. The separately reviewed eight Node tests use pure wire checks, mock metadata/selection, a read-only temporary settings backend, optional per-model default getters and effective sampling-object merges; the runner apply and SDK probe entry points are not called.
Release 0.30.10-81: previous approved fingerprint verified; only four version metadata values changed. Local WhatsApp question relay changes touch the WhatsApp event broker and health capability, outside the 19 approved Prompt test call paths; their fake-broker test is compile-only and no database test was added.
